description: OptimistFi's perps desk: stories, traders with checked calls, wallets covered, companies that blocked tokenized trading of their stock, Kalshi's BTC/ETH odds and perp funding. Use when the user asks: perps news on X; is trader Y worth following; Kalshi's BTC odds. Args: view; market; trader; wallet; limit.

dex.description: account view only: Hyperliquid builder dex name, e.g. xyz; empty reads the main dex.
dex.title: Dex

market.description: news and traders: one market (BTC, NVDA, gold). tokenized: one company by ticker or name (MSFT, Microsoft). kalshi: BTC or ETH.
market.title: Market

max_age_s.description: account only: maximum source age in seconds, default 3. A stale or undated account is unavailable.
max_age_s.title: Max Age S

trader.description: traders: one trader by name or X handle.
trader.title: Trader

view.description: news: the desk's published perps stories, newest first. traders: the perps traders directory, with the desk's checked calls on each. wallets: the Hyperliquid wallets the desk has covered, with their stories. account: a fresh public Hyperliquid wallet state on one dex, with positions and margin; wallet is required. tokenized: which companies have blocked tokenized trading of their stock, from each venue's public notice. kalshi: Kalshi's BTC and ETH odds for the next 5 PM ET close and Friday's beside its perps' funding, read every five minutes, with its daily study of perps volume against open interest.
view.title: View

wallet.description: wallets: one 0x address; adds what it holds now.
wallet.title: Wallet

name: get_perps_desk
title: Perps desk — news, traders and wallets
